About KME

A Level 1 contributor built on trust.

Khanyi Micro Enterprise (Pty) Ltd is a Level 1 contributor company delivering painting, electrical fault finding, tiling, paving and allied building services.

Led by director Khanyisile Mvelase, the company has won numerous projects across the private sector, earning repeat confidence through consistent delivery.
